title: MIDNIGHT TRANSIT
hook: A mechanical moth carries the last second through a monumental clock.
shots: Macro clock mechanism; one amber second wakes the moth.
Dry ticks; tiny metal latch; descending air.
Camera follows the moth down a red-lit industrial corridor.
Clock blades close; moth folds its wings and dives through.
Mechanical slam; impact and short ringing tail.
Time capsule strikes the clock core; rings burst outward.
Brief hold, then glass burst and sub impact.
Released amber light travels through the city; moth flies toward the sunrise.
Warm resolving chord; distant metal tail.
